rule: an environment keeps its identity across framings; no empty generic plates

environments.name: The frozen square
environments.description: Snowbound village square at night, bell post at centre, two rows of houses with warm windows.
environments.lighting: moon key (cool, high), window pools (warm, low), no fill outside the pools

environments.name: The keeper's threshold
environments.description: Open door seen from the snow: warm interior with a hanging lamp, cold blue night outside.
environments.lighting: practical lamp as key, cold night as rim, hard warm/cold split

environments.name: Close-up plate
environments.description: Out-of-focus night with bokeh lamps and a window mullion; the actor carries the shot.
environments.lighting: warm key from camera left, cold ambient, no hard shadows

environments.name: The graveyard at first light
environments.description: Snow field, fence, headstones, an open grave and a soil mound; low sun behind the treeline.
environments.lighting: contre-jour low sun, long soft shadows towards camera, cold bounce from snow
environments.weather: clear, cold haze near the ground

environments.name: The bell
environments.description: Insert of the bronze bell on its headstock, frost and dust in the light.
environments.lighting: single warm source from below-left, deep blue ambient
